Wild turkey hunting is still prohibited on all public and private areas of Oʻahu. Game mammal hunting is closed during the bird season. Public vehicle access to Makua Keaʻau beyond the Farrington Highway gate is unavailable until further notice (storm damage); Kuaokalā requires U.S. Space Force guard-shack clearance and DOFAW check-in. The statewide mourning dove cutoff (Jan. 10, 2027) does not apply on this island because mourning dove is not listed here.
